analyst_view.overall: Juventus (7th) host 19th-placed Venezia in the Sunday lunch game. Juventus are getting players back: Conceicao is in full training, and Cambiaso and Nico Gonzalez are progressing toward a return. Zhegrova, counted as out, is at risk but with some optimism; Yildiz, Kalulu and Locatelli remain out.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals and cut Juventus's attack for Zhegrova. Conceicao is back in training and Nico Gonzalez is close (Tuttomercatoweb, 12 Nov), and one report says there is optimism on Zhegrova too, so I lean mildly higher to about 2.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.9 corners, already lifted by Juventus's recent corner count. Nothing new to add.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.8 cards and already count Arena's low card record. I found nothing new.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.4 shots. Returning wide players (Conceicao, possibly Nico Gonzalez and Cambiaso) should help Juventus create a little more; about 31.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 shots on target. Juventus's returning attackers are the reason for a small nudge up, to about 9.3.
